overview.description: The VanEck Energy TruSector ETF (TRUN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in energy equity. The fund is actively managed, seeking long-term capital appreciation through exposure to US companies in the energy sector. Stock selection uses a discretionary investment process TRUN was launched on Jul 7, 2026 and is issued by VanEck.
